title: Transition-Aware Verification of AI-Generated Infrastructure Security Patches: code, synthetic data and results
description:
Experiment code, synthetic data and supplied numerical results for Transition-Aware Verification of AI-Generated Infrastructure Security Patches.

The archive contains scripts, input CSVs, result tables and figures. Data are entirely synthetic. The raw-data generator is not included; the experiments run from the included CSV files. See the repository README for installation, reproduction commands and limitations.

Source repository: https://github.com/Akhilmadineni/transition-aware-patch-verification.
